comment: No family is written for INPUT, OUT or REV: the module fans out whatever voltage it is given and gives it no meaning of its own. getCombinedValue at src/SDFormation.cpp:77 is what makes 10V cover a knob's whole span — the CV is multiplied by the attenuverter and by (max - min) / 10 before being added, then the total is clamped to the knob's own range. The centred setting uses a per-voice tilt factor built from tiltMin 0.255 (src/SDFormation.cpp:35) rather than the straight-line factor the up and down settings use. The eight random numbers are uniform 0 to 1 and are stored in the patch (src/SDFormation.cpp:144).
